system.description:
You amplify constructs made of earth causing them to manifest an aura of Earth Release Chakra. Select an Earthen Artifact of your creation within range. All creatures of your choice within 30 feet of the chosen construct gains a +1 bonus to their AC, as you decrease their weight, increasing their speed.

Additionally, hostile creatures of your choice within range who first enter or begin their turn in the radius must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save has a -1 penalty to their AC until they begin their turn outside of this jutsu’s radius. If a creature who failed their save would exit and reenter the area, they do not remake their save, instead automatically being affected by the penalty. If they would exit and re-enter this jutsu’s radius after previously passing, they must remake their saving throw.

Regardless of either effect a creature is under as a result of this jutsu, it can be affected by no more than 2 different auras created by this jutsu.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of Earthen Artifacts you can select by +1. Casting this jutsu at B-Rank, increase the AC bonus to +2. Casting this jutsu at S-Rank, increase the AC bonus to +3.
